mission: 最终只读裁决复核：新报告是否夸大因果/样本/增量/质量资格或提前关闭未完成任务
task_scope: 只读新报告、保存结果清单/两结果/已有审查；不联网不跑市场或重复数值检验
只返回会影响结论的错误，核用户关心的多用途、六ETF范围、平均的语义、资料样例与研究池区分、任务归属
仅做一轮有依据的最终检查，不扩大新问题
expected_outputs: 是否执行该诊断/需改何处/能支持什么，最多1000字
stop_conditions: 不修改旧定义或预算；旧研究不重跑

proposed_design.input: saved formal/daily.csv and pairs.csv only; verify original output hashes and source inventory; no new score or outcome
proposed_design.motivation: old report has no quantified date-dependence uncertainty and primary rank mean slightly positive but high-minus-all negative; need assess whether range rules out/implies any benefit, not rescue result
proposed_design.statistics: paired circular moving blocks of calendar-ordered date rows up through last eligible outcome (keep two in-range NA dates); same resampled rows for rank_ic, high-minus-low, high-minus-six. Fixed length21 primary,63 sensitivity, 2000 resamples each seed20261019; percentile95 interval of date mean; source small retrospective pool not independent confirmation. No p-value or fabricated meaningful threshold
proposed_design.other_checks: recalculate headline from saved outputs; original five periods/51 anchors reused; exact per-asset high-minus-all contribution and leave-one-original-period-out summaries as descriptive concentration, no selection or model
proposed_design.boundary: new supplementary saved-result diagnosis recorded as exploratory 1batch; original formal+independent run budgets not reused/reset, output external. Not costs/account/production; sampling assumptions and short history limit intervals

diagnosis_to_challenge: largest research-side bottleneck appears lack of qualified cross-sectional candidate data and use-specific incremental evidence, not more indicators or workflow documents. Need distinguish legitimate no effect, insufficient data and incomplete review/acceptance. Cannot prove causal allocation of months of delay or label all research failure.
